title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - Clock
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/Clock. [COSEM] This class models the device clock, managing all information related to date and time including deviations of the local time to a generalized time reference (UTC) due to time zones and daylight-saving time schemes.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Clock'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTime.description: Property. [COSEM] Meter's local date and time.

hasTimeZone.description: Property. [COSEM] The deviation of local, normal time to UTC in minutes. The value depends on the geographical location of the meter.

hasClockBase.description: Property. [COSEM] Defines where the basic timing information comes from: (0) not defined, (1) internal crystal, (2) mains frequency 50 Hz, (3) mains frequency 60 Hz, (4) GPS (global positioning system), (5) radio controlled.

hasDaylightSavingsBegin.description: Property. [COSEM] Defines the local switch date and time when the local time starts to deviate from the normal time.

hasDaylightSavingsEnd.description: Property. [COSEM] Defines the local switch date and time when the local time ends to deviate from the local normal time.

hasDaylightSavingsDeviation.description: Property. [COSEM] Contains the number of minutes by which the deviation in generalized time shall be corrected at daylight savings begin.

hasDaylightSavingsEnabled.description: Property. [COSEM] Enable and disable the daylight savings time feature.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code uniquely identifying this clock COSEM object.
